HOW IT WORKS · 01

We put your brand where travellers already are.

Homepage Banner Placement

Your brand is featured on the Beli Holiday homepage, the first thing travellers see when searching for their next holiday. Clicking your homepage banner takes them directly to your dedicated brand page, where they can discover your story, explore your travel packages, view your latest offers, and learn more about your brand.

Placement: Beliholiday.com homepage  ·  Format: Banner

Facebook & Instagram Targeting

We retarget travellers using our own first-party Beli Holiday audiences across Facebook and Instagram, on Feed, Stories and Reels. Your destination gets promoted directly to people who have already shown intent to travel, not cold, unqualified audiences.

Placements: FB & IG Feed, Stories, Reels  ·  Audience: Beli Holiday first-party
